content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make an apple sponge, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sift the flour into a large mixing bowl (2 minutes)
Step 2. Cream the butter and sugar together until light (10 minutes)
Step 3. Peel the Granny Smith apples (5 minutes)
Step 4. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture (4 minutes)
Step 5. Beat the eggs lightly in a separate cup (2 minutes)
Step 6. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit (15 minutes)
Step 7. Grease the bottom of the springform pan (1 minute)
Step 8. Wash the fresh apples thoroughly (2 minutes)
Step 9. Measure out the vanilla extract (30 seconds)
Step 10. Check the expiration date on the baking powder (1 minute)
Step 11. Crack the eggs into a small bowl (1 minute)
Step 12. Soften the butter at room temperature (45 minutes)
Step 13. Zest a fresh lemon (3 minutes)
Step 14. Set aside the egg shells for composting (1 minute)
Step 15. Measure the granulated sugar (1 minute)
Step 16. Organize all necessary baking utensils on the counter (5 minutes)
Step 17. Sift the cornstarch to remove lumps (2 minutes)
Step 18. Whisk the eggs with the vanilla extract (3 minutes)
Step 19. Core the washed apples (4 minutes)
Step 20. Slice the apples into thin wedges (6 minutes)
Step 21. Measure the all-purpose flour (2 minutes)
Step 22. Adjust the oven rack to the middle position (30 seconds)
Step 23. Measure the baking powder (1 minute)
Step 24. Prepare a damp cloth for cleaning spills (2 minutes)
Step 25. Clean the mixing area (10 minutes)
Step 26. Clear the kitchen island workspace (5 minutes)
Step 27. Combine the dry leavening agents (2 minutes)
Step 28. Arrange apple slices on top of the batter (8 minutes)
Step 29. Add lemon zest to the mixture (1 minute)
Step 30. Retrieve the apples from the pantry (1 minute)
Step 31. Combine the sifted flour and cornstarch (2 minutes)
Step 32. Pat the apple slices dry with a paper towel (3 minutes)
Step 33. Lightly flour the sides of the cake pan (2 minutes)
Step 34. Toss the peeled apples in a bit of lemon juice (2 minutes)
Step 35. Gather the remaining wet ingredients (3 minutes)
Step 36. Calibrate the kitchen scale (2 minutes)
Step 37. Empty the dishwasher to make room for dirty bowls (15 minutes)
Step 38. Check the pantry for cinnamon (1 minute)
Step 39. Combine the creamed butter with the sugar (5 minutes)
Step 40. Incorporate the beaten eggs into the butter mixture (4 minutes)
Step 41. Spread the sponge batter into the prepared pan (5 minutes)
Step 42. Place the scale on a flat surface (30 seconds)
Step 43. Measure the whole milk (1 minute)
Step 44. Chop a portion of the apples into small cubes (7 minutes)
Step 45. Put away the sugar container (2 minutes)
Step 46. Warm the milk slightly in the microwave (45 seconds)
Step 47. Mix the cinnamon into the batter (1 minute)
Step 48. Fold the cubed apples into the sponge base (3 minutes)
Step 49. Set out the mixing bowls (2 minutes)
Step 50. Wipe down the milk carton (30 seconds)
Step 51. Pour the milk into the batter (1 minute)
Step 52. Check the oven thermometer (1 minute)
Step 53. Weigh the sugar on the scale (2 minutes)
Step 54. Sanitize the workspace (5 minutes)
Step 55. Smooth the top of the batter with a spatula (2 minutes)
Step 56. Line the pan with parchment paper (3 minutes)
Step 57. Whisk the dry ingredients one last time (1 minute)
Step 58. Find the lemon in the refrigerator (1 minute)
Step 59. Dust the pan with a little extra sugar (1 minute)
Step 60. Double check the egg consistency (1 minute)
